chaosSurges.effDesc: Unstable tectonic rift ruptures. -15 HP damage!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ THE CHAOS CORE RUPTURED (Roll 1): Dynamic tectonic rifts snap directly under your coordinates! Spikes burst forth, inflicting -15 HP damage!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Toxic spore pods explode in the vicinity. Inflicts -12 HP damage and spawns an active hazard.
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 2): Ruptured toxic spore vents spray toxic fumes! Inflicted -12 HP damage and activated a volatile vent trap nearby!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Corrosive fog dissolves equipment. Weapons and equipped armor decay by -20 durability!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 3): Heavy acid mist rolls through. Current weapon and armor decayed by -20 durability!

chaosSurges.effDesc: An unstable static discharge drains -15 Focus (MP) and summons a Void Rat.
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 4): Static discharge drains -15 Focus (MP) and conjures a Void-Crazed Static Rat!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Sunder outlaws pickpocket your coinpurse. Drains up to -30 Gold directly!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 5): Phantom bandits steal Gold from your pouch!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Atmospheric friction backfires on your spell cells. Drains -25 Focus (MP)!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 6): Magical feedback backfires in your core cells, burning away -25 Focus (MP)!

chaosSurges.effDesc: A localized freezing wind drains your stamina. -10 HP and -10 Focus (MP) damage.
chaosSurges.logText: ⚠️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 7): Absolute zero cold drafts freeze your joints! Drained -10 HP and -10 Focus (MP) simultaneously.

chaosSurges.effDesc: Vibrations in the ground move tectonic rifts, spawning 2 volatile active hazard traps nearby!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚡ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 8): Tectonic stress shifts the ground beneath! Activated 2 volatile hazard traps adjacent to your position!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Aetheric feedback triggers genetic advancement. Mutates an active monster to an Elite form!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚡ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 9): Magical aether overflows! Mutant energy surges through monster!

chaosSurges.effDesc: A crystal catalyst reacts violently. Explodes for -6 HP, but drops raw wood/iron residue in your pack!
chaosSurges.logText: ⚡ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 10): An unstable crystal catalyst detonates! Dealed -6 HP damage, but molecular fallout added +2 Wood and +1 Iron to your pack!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Pure elements condense directly into a rare Catalyst.
chaosSurges.logText: 🔮 CHAOS SURGE (Roll 11): Rare elements condense out of thin air.

chaosSurges.effDesc: Pure elements condense directly into a rare Catalyst.
chaosSurges.logText: 🔮 CHAOS SURGE (Roll 12): Rare elements condense out of thin air.

chaosSurges.effDesc: Sweet berries grow. Adds +3 Wild Berries and +1 Bread to your pack.
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 13): Woodland elements condense. Added +3 Wild Berries and +1 Bread to your food inventory!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Atmospheric copper coins fuse together. Grants +45 Gold directly.
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 14): Flashing aurum particles fuse! Added +45 Gold to your inventory.

chaosSurges.effDesc: A localized spatial rift spawns wood and iron. Adds +2 Wood and +2 Iron to your materials.
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 15): A minor spatial rift deposits crafting supplies. Gained +2 Wood and +2 Iron!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Aetheric particles solidify into lockpicks. Adds +2 Lockpicks to your inventory.
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 16): Metallic static aligns into functional shapes. Gained +2 Lockpicks in your storage pack!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Heals +25 HP, restores +15 Mana, and disperses surrounding map fog.
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 17): Peaceful dynamic waves wash over you. Restored +25 HP and +15 Focus, and fully charted nearby terrain!

chaosSurges.effDesc: A flash of pure light reveals hidden traps and grants +35 Scouting XP.
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 18): Cosmic foresight floods your awareness. All hidden traps in the level have been detected, and gained +35 Scouting XP!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Dungeon static aligns with iron molecules, repairing equipped weapon and armor durability by +50!
chaosSurges.logText: ✨ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 19): Tectonic forge light shines upon you. Repaired +50 durability on your equipped weapon, armor, and shield!

chaosSurges.effDesc: Full HP & MP restored, +100 Gold awarded, and a Glazed Boar spawned.
chaosSurges.logText: ☄️ CHAOS SURGE (Roll 20 - PERFECT HARMONY): The cosmic matrix reaches absolute focus! Fully restored HP and MP, and added +100 Gold!

encounters.name: Seraphic Healing Breeze
encounters.description: GM notices the player is in near-lethal danger and casts a protective divine aura.

encounters.name: Sovereign Rift Ambush
encounters.description: GM gets high irritation from idling or over-preparedness, tearing open a void rift spawning custom monsters.

encounters.name: Alchemical Drop
encounters.description: The storyteller summons a Volatile Alchemical Sprite near the player, loaded with premium alchemical catalysts.

encounters.name: Lightning Bolt Smite
encounters.description: The storyteller strikes lightning on a hostile enemy when feeling charitable or seeking explosive balance.

encounters.name: Acoustic Hazard Alarm
encounters.description: Sadistic or mischievous storytelling spawns dynamic spike traps beneath the feet of neighboring spaces.

encounters.name: Meteorological Climax
encounters.description: GM rapidly forces an overworld environmental phase transition to high elemental tension.

encounters.name: Arcane Gale Torrent
encounters.description: When the player depletes their mana reservoir, the storyteller channels a dense stream of raw ether directly to them.

encounters.name: Sovereign Light-Guardian
encounters.description: GM spawns an Ethereal Holy Paladin ally nearby to aid the player in moments of heavy battlefield stress or boss showdowns.

encounters.name: Primal Resource Bounty
encounters.description: The storyteller manifests Ilmarinen's rogue Ore Thief nearby, a fast goblin carrying premium metals and ores.

encounters.name: Alchemical Mana Leak
encounters.description: A mischievous GM causes the player to lose some Mana (MP) because of alchemical leakage.

encounters.name: Goblin's Hidden Toll
encounters.description: The GM directly drains some gold from the player's pockets because they are carrying too much treasure.

encounters.name: Acidic Alloy Tarnish
encounters.description: An acidic environmental smog causes the durability of the players equipped weapon or shields to decay.

encounters.name: Tectonic Earthquake Tremor
encounters.description: A sudden seismic shockwave deals minor strain damage to both you and active hostile monsters.

encounters.name: Dimensional Phase Blur
encounters.description: A transient reality glitch blurs coordinate spaces, pushing nearby hostiles 1 tile away from the player.

encounters.name: Leyline Acoustic Resonance
encounters.description: An acoustic wave of ancient ley energy restores 15 focus mana points to the player.

encounters.name: Wilderness Fauna Spawn
encounters.description: A passive woodland beast wanders onto the active coordinate matrix.

encounters.name: Ukko's Golden Bolt
encounters.description: Ukko Ylijumala strikes a massive golden lightning bolt, purging nearest enemy and infusing player with sky-sparks.

encounters.name: Väinämöinen's Rune-Song
encounters.description: Väinämöinen sings the ancient runes of creation, putting all nearby enemies to sleep/calm and healing the player.

encounters.name: Mielikki's Honey Drop
encounters.description: Mielikki, Queen of the Forest, spawns a glowing Honey-Glazed Boar that flees from the player, dropping cooked meats and honey.

encounters.name: Roaming Outlaw Camp
encounters.description: The GM spawns a small camp of 2-3 Outlaw Bandits around a newly lit wood campfire nearby, accompanied by a dynamic lore announcement.

narrativePrompts.Sadistic: HP ratio is low. Should I introduce a poison gas hazard or let them crawl in blood?
narrativePrompts.Benevolent: Player is exerting valiant coordination on this grid. Perhaps a healing spark or alloy cluster falls near.
narrativePrompts.Mischievous: Too quiet. Let's mutate the chunk configuration or drop a trap adjacent to their next footstep.
narrativePrompts.Intrigued: Watching coordinate vector. Autonomous GM active and monitoring...
narrativePrompts.Apathetic: Observing silently as the mortal wanders the realm.
